question: Which service profile is affected if the default host firmware policy in Cisco UCS Manager is changed?
options: any service profile that uses the global-default host firmware policy
any service profile that uses a user-created host firmware policy
any service profile that has no host firmware policy defined
any service profile that is not in the root sub-org
theory: The 'default' host firmware policy in Cisco UCS Manager only applies automatically to service profiles that do not have an explicit host firmware package assigned to them — it acts as a fallback, not a global override. Service profiles that reference their own user-created (non-default) host firmware policy are unaffected by changes to the default policy, since they already point to a different, specific policy object. This distinction between 'default policy used as fallback' versus 'explicitly assigned policy' is what determines the blast radius of a default policy change. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 14 — UCS Firmware Management, Default Host Firmware Package)
